en.headline: Hang Seng closes 240 points higher, up 1 percent
en.dek: The index finished Tuesday at 24,280 after an early jump faded, with drug shares leading and turnover near 98.3 billion dollars.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed 240 points higher on Tuesday, finishing at 24,280, a gain of 1 percent, according to RTHK's market report.
The index rose more than 310 points in early trade and touched 24,354 before the advance narrowed. Main-board turnover was close to 98.3 billion dollars.
Drug shares were among the stronger performers. WuXi AppTec, Sino Biopharmaceutical and WuXi Biologics rose by nearly 3 percent to nearly 5 percent, the report said.

The Hang Seng Tech Index ended at 4,223, up nearly 1 percent. Zhipu gained nearly 8 percent and MiniMax rose more than 2 percent, while Kuaishou and Baidu gained more than 2 percent and more than 3 percent respectively.

Heavyweight financials were mixed. HSBC rose nearly 2 percent, Hong Kong Exchanges was steady, and AIA was softer. Consumer names faced selling, with Anta Sports down nearly 3 percent and Nongfu Spring down nearly 2 percent.

zh.headline: 恆指收市升240點 全日升約1%
zh.dek: 港股星期二收報24280點，初段升幅其後收窄，醫藥股領漲，主板成交近983億元。
body: 港股星期二造好。香港電台報道，恆生指數收市報24280點，升240點，升幅1%。
指數初段升逾310點，高見24354點，其後升幅收窄。主板成交近983億元。
醫藥股表現較好。報道指，藥明康德、中國生物製藥及藥明生物分別升近3%至近5%。
恆生科技指數收報4223點，升幅近1%。智譜升近8%，MiniMax升逾2%；快手及百度分別升逾2%及逾3%。
重磅金融股個別發展，匯控升近2%，港交所靠穩，友邦偏軟。內需股受沽壓，安踏體育跌近3%，農夫山泉跌近2%。
